result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The most notable defect is a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where 'Green Bowl Poké' appears twice with identical image, delivery time, and price. No other significant visual breakages were detected.

issues.description: Duplicate restaurant card: 'Green Bowl Poké' (15–25 min, €0.90 delivery) appears twice side by side in the 'Fastest near you' carousel with identical image and details, suggesting a data or rendering deduplication bug.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate items in the carousel data source (e.g., filter by unique restaurant ID before rendering) so each restaurant appears only once.
